title: What Neighborhood Resilience Hubs Is
definition: Neighborhood Resilience Hubs: hubs coordinating neighborhood resilience.
description:
Neighborhood Resilience Hubs: hubs coordinating neighborhood resilience. This is Future Safety & Civilization Resilience at its most ambitious — hub buildings research, hub logistics engineering and solar+storage operations converging on a single goal: making hub hulls real.

Why it matters: Future Safety & Civilization Resilience will decide trusted leaders outcomes this century. Neighborhood Resilience Hubs is one of the load-bearing ideas: without working hub hulls, the larger hub buildings vision stalls, and with it, the hub logistics systems that depend on it.

This database documents Neighborhood Resilience Hubs in full: what it is, the real research behind it today, the pieces it is built from, dated forecasts, runnable demo programs, and a teaching ladder from foundations to mastery. Every record carries a working program you can run.

title: Readiness Estimator: Neighborhood Resilience Hubs
definition: Estimates Neighborhood Resilience Hubs readiness from component maturity.
description:
The estimator scores the six Neighborhood Resilience Hubs components on the TRL 1–9 scale and averages them into a verdict: research phase, pilot phase, or deployment phase. Scores derive from the component records in this database — change a component's maturity and the verdict moves.

Honest scoring is the point: a hub hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

title: Neighborhood Resilience Hubs Systems Simulator
definition: Simulates Neighborhood Resilience Hubs operating for a day.
description:
The simulator walks a Neighborhood Resilience Hubs installation through six operating steps, with seeded randomness standing in for real-world variation. Seed 15484 reproduces this exact run — change the seed in the program to explore other days.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where hub buildings monitoring, hub logistics redundancy, or solar+storage maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Neighborhood Resilience Hubs Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Neighborhood Resilience Hubs: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Neighborhood Resilience Hubs — hubs coordinating neighborhood resilience.

Phase 1 — Prove (hub buildings): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (hub logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (solar+storage): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (trusted leaders): hub hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and neighborhoods-scale deployment begins.

Public edition: phases follow documented research readiness. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.
